featured.name: RAG Lab
featured.tagline: Learn RAG by watching it work.
featured.description: An interactive, local-first lab for every decision in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline: chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval, reranking, generation and evaluation. Every algorithm is drawn as it runs, including the HNSW graph traversal, cosine-similarity heatmaps and the final scoring radar.
featured.imageAlt: Animated demo of RAG Lab chunking, embedding and retrieving a document

run.requirements: Python 3.10+ and Node.js 18+. No API keys or cloud accounts.
steps: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
